name: SkillHand
summary: SkillHand is AgiBot's integrated dexterous hand developed for precise robotic manipulation and presented with the first-generation Expedition A1 humanoid. The manufacturer identifies 12 actively driven degrees of freedom and five passive degrees of freedom, with all drives contained inside the hand. Vision-based fingertip sensors add contact perception to its mechanical movement. The official A1 presentation establishes the hand's design and integration context, but does not provide a separate current sales specification or confirm standalone delivery availability.
